subject: 🏃 Friday — Full Rest, PAL 10K Eve (Wk 4)
html:
Tomorrow is full rest — no run, no gym, no shakeout. This was already the plan before the cold showed up, and the cold only makes it more important. Twenty-four hours of zero training load before a benchmark race is the prescription; your body gets to focus entirely on recovering from this virus and topping off glycogen.

The PAL 10K go/no-go call happens twice tomorrow. First check: Friday evening. Second check: Saturday morning before you leave the house. The five-point checklist hasn't changed: (1) no fever in the last 24 hours, (2) symptoms above-the-neck only — no chest involvement, (3) resting HR within 5 bpm of baseline, (4) energy near-normal, (5) symptoms clearly improving, not just holding. All five must hold. Any miss → DNS. The PAL 10K is a calibration race; Presidio HM is the Pivot test in 3.5 weeks. No scenario where forcing a benchmark race sick serves the marathon.

Race prep if you're trending go: Lay out your race kit tonight — Metaspeed Sky Tokyo, H10 strap (double-check battery), race bib, shorts, singlet. Pre-mix your Maurten Drink Mix 160 bottle (40g carbs, 60 min pre-start with a banana). Stage one Maurten Gel 100 for the mile 3.5 single-gel test. Half LMNT packet ready for a 14 oz handheld if you want sodium.

Focus cue: Be honest with yourself at both checkpoints. You skipped Thursday's run — smart call, zero training cost. If Friday night feels like you're 80% recovered and trending up, Saturday is on. If you're still stuffed up with poor sleep and flat energy, the race will still be there in another form — we'll retool the calibration around Presidio or find a flat 10K in June.

Context: Week 4 of 12, Phase 1 Foundation — 58 days to race day. You've banked a clean VO2 set Tuesday (6×1000m, all inside 6:50–7:00, knee 1/5), a taper-light strength session Wednesday with the full PT block, and two smart rest days. The fitness is there; the question is whether the cold clears in time to express it. Sunday is 6 mi recovery regardless of Saturday's outcome.

Tonight: Hydrate, zinc + Vit C, bed by 9:30. Track your resting HR before sleep and again on waking — that 12-hour delta is the clearest signal you'll have for the Friday-night call.
